scientific_integrity.computation_role: Optional independent exact-rational finite witness and consistency checks, not a universal certificate.
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: Unrestricted measurable probability spaces; analytical proof by label lifting and tensor variation.

scientific_limitations: Only the sharp two-coordinate coefficient for arbitrary probability measures is proved.
Sharpness is a limiting three-atom family; no positive-distance attainment is claimed.
Optimal constants for three or more coordinates and all extremizer families are not determined.
An unindexed prior equivalent might exist; priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp two-coordinate total-variation homogenization over arbitrary probability spaces
